description: This Swift source file defines the GatewayConnectionController class, which manages gateway discovery, connection, TLS fingerprint verification, and auto-reconnection logic for an iOS application. It handles network resolution, TLS pinning, and device permissions, integrating with various system and app-specific modules.

classes.name: GatewayConnectionController
classes.description: Manages gateway discovery, connection, TLS fingerprint verification, and auto-reconnection for an iOS app.

classes.name: TrustPrompt
classes.description: Represents a trust prompt for TLS fingerprint verification, identifiable and equatable.

classes.name: GatewayTLSFingerprintProbe
classes.description: Probes TLS fingerprint of a gateway URL by performing a TLS handshake and extracting the certificate fingerprint.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the controller, optionally starting gateway discovery.

methods.name: setDiscoveryDebugLoggingEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables debug logging for gateway discovery.

methods.name: setScenePhase
methods.description: Handles app scene phase changes to start or stop discovery accordingly.

methods.name: allowAutoConnectAgain
methods.description: Resets auto-connection state to allow auto-connecting again.

methods.name: restartDiscovery
methods.description: Restarts gateway discovery process.

methods.name: connectWithDiagnostics
methods.description: Attempts to connect to a discovered gateway, returning an error message if failed.

methods.name: connectDiscoveredGateway
methods.description: Handles connection logic to a discovered gateway, including TLS verification and auto-connection.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Connects to a discovered gateway asynchronously.

methods.name: connectManual
methods.description: Connects manually to a specified host and port, with optional TLS.

methods.name: connectLastKnown
methods.description: Attempts to connect to the last known gateway based on stored settings.

methods.name: refreshActiveGatewayRegistrationFromSettings
methods.description: Rebuilds and reapplies current gateway connection options based on local settings.

methods.name: clearPendingTrustPrompt
methods.description: Clears any pending TLS trust prompt.

methods.name: acceptPendingTrustPrompt
methods.description: Accepts the pending TLS trust prompt, saving the fingerprint and initiating connection.

methods.name: declinePendingTrustPrompt
methods.description: Declines the trust prompt, setting status to offline.

methods.name: updateFromDiscovery
methods.description: Updates internal gateway list and status from discovery results.

methods.name: observeDiscovery
methods.description: Sets up observation for discovery changes to trigger updates.

methods.name: maybeAutoConnect
methods.description: Attempts auto-connection based on user preferences and previous state.

methods.name: updateLastDiscoveredGateway
methods.description: Stores the first discovered gateway's ID if user preferences allow.

methods.name: startAutoConnect
methods.description: Initiates an automatic connection with provided parameters.

methods.name: resolveDiscoveredTLSParams
methods.description: Resolves TLS parameters for a discovered gateway, considering stored pins.

methods.name: resolveManualTLSParams
methods.description: Resolves TLS parameters for manual connection, considering stored pins.

methods.name: probeTLSFingerprint
methods.description: Probes the TLS fingerprint of a URL asynchronously.

methods.name: resolveServiceEndpoint
methods.description: Resolves a network endpoint to host and port, handling service discovery.

methods.name: resolveHostPortFromBonjourEndpoint
methods.description: Resolves Bonjour (mDNS) endpoints to host and port.

methods.name: resolveBonjourServiceToHostPort
methods.description: Resolves a Bonjour service to host and port, using NetService with timeout.

methods.name: buildGatewayURL
methods.description: Constructs a WebSocket URL with ws or wss scheme.

methods.name: resolveManualUseTLS
methods.description: Determines whether to use TLS for manual host/port, considering host requirements.

methods.name: shouldRequireTLS
methods.description: Checks if a host should require TLS based on hostname.

methods.name: shouldForceTLS
methods.description: Checks if a host should be forced to TLS based on suffix.

methods.name: isLoopbackHost
methods.description: Determines if a hostname is a loopback address.

methods.name: isLoopbackIPv4
methods.description: Checks if an IPv4 address is loopback.

methods.name: isLoopbackIPv6
methods.description: Checks if an IPv6 address is loopback.

methods.name: manualStableID
methods.description: Generates a manual stable ID string from host and port.

methods.name: makeConnectOptions
methods.description: Creates connection options including capabilities, commands, and permissions.

methods.name: resolvedClientId
methods.description: Resolves the client ID for connection, considering overrides and manual settings.

methods.name: resolveManualPort
methods.description: Resolves the port for manual connection, defaulting based on TLS requirement.

methods.name: resolvedDisplayName
methods.description: Resolves and stores a display name for the device.

methods.name: currentCaps
methods.description: Returns the list of capabilities based on device permissions and features.

methods.name: currentCommands
methods.description: Returns the list of commands supported based on capabilities.

methods.name: currentPermissions
methods.description: Returns current device permissions status for various features.

methods.name: isLocationAuthorized
methods.description: Checks if location permission is authorized.

methods.name: hasEventKitAccess
methods.description: Checks if EventKit access is granted.

methods.name: motionAvailable
methods.description: Checks if device motion or pedometer is available.
